citations.C2: `TypeError` when a value is `None` (empty CSV cell parsed as null) — treat `None` as a validation failure
citations.C4: `ValueError` on formatted money like `"$1,299.00"` or `"1 299,00"` — strip currency symbols and separators
citations.C5: `int("3.0")` raises even though the value is a valid whole number
citations.C6: Binary floats can't represent cents exactly, so the total drifts — use `decimal.Decimal`
citations.C7: Negative price or qty passes silently, so a corrupt row can subtract revenue
citations.C8: `float("nan")` and `float("inf")` are accepted silently and poison the entire total
citations.C9: catch per row, attach the index and raw values
